decisions.reason: Turnaround management software sits at the core of the firm's announced shift to data-driven, integrated airport operations and has had its own page for two years, so the sunk investment and public commitment strongly favor persisting.

Visibility rose from a mention to a dedicated page in 2024, which signals growing commitment to a connectivity module that underpins the integrated apron data platform, and any weak results can still be put down to slow airport adoption.

The billing software was upgraded to its own page in 2024 and supports the firm's expansion into software and services, so management will justify the investment and give it more time, even though it is a little further from the airside core.
Equipment monitoring builds directly on the firm's large installed base and lifecycle service strategy, and its new dedicated page in 2024 shows rising public commitment.
